name: main-smoke
note: Gated stage of the main profile (pipeline --profile main): a short smoke of the frozen code before lab-main and svc-main. C2 early/late x Firebreak, Trace & quarantine, G-Safeguard, No containment, and svc early/late x Firebreak, No containment, once each: 12 runs, about 20 min. The gate blocks on run status, scorer integrity, Firebreak clean, no tainted commit after tau_1, testbed failures and every site's sent-to-confirmed p99 <= L (400 ms); hand-offs are recorded only.
